public.v_contacts_activity.definition:
select "contacts"."id", "contacts"."tenant_id", "contacts"."name", "contacts"."company_id", max("activities"."occurred_at") as "last_activity_at" from "contacts" left join "activities" on ("activities"."tenant_id" = "contacts"."tenant_id" and "activities"."contact_id" = "contacts"."id") where current_setting('app.analytics_scope', true) = 'tenant' OR exists (select "deals"."id" from "deals" left join "employees" on ("employees"."tenant_id" = "deals"."tenant_id" and "employees"."id" = "deals"."responsible_employee_id") where ("deals"."tenant_id" = "contacts"."tenant_id" and "deals"."contact_id" = "contacts"."id" and (
    current_setting('app.analytics_scope', true) = 'tenant'
    OR (current_setting('app.analytics_scope', true) = 'department'
      AND "employees"."department_id" = nullif(current_setting('app.analytics_department_id', true), '')::uuid)
    OR (current_setting('app.analytics_scope', true) = 'employee'
      AND "deals"."responsible_employee_id" = nullif(current_setting('app.analytics_employee_id', true), '')::uuid)
  ))) group by "contacts"."id", "contacts"."tenant_id", "contacts"."name", "contacts"."company_id"
public.v_contacts_activity.name: v_contacts_activity

public.v_deals.definition:
select "deals"."id", "deals"."tenant_id", "deals"."title", "deals"."status", "deals"."amount", "deals"."currency", "deals"."created_at", "deals"."closed_at", "deals"."company_id", "deals"."contact_id", "deals"."responsible_employee_id", "employees"."department_id" from "deals" left join "employees" on ("employees"."tenant_id" = "deals"."tenant_id" and "employees"."id" = "deals"."responsible_employee_id") where (
    current_setting('app.analytics_scope', true) = 'tenant'
    OR (current_setting('app.analytics_scope', true) = 'department'
      AND "employees"."department_id" = nullif(current_setting('app.analytics_department_id', true), '')::uuid)
    OR (current_setting('app.analytics_scope', true) = 'employee'
      AND "deals"."responsible_employee_id" = nullif(current_setting('app.analytics_employee_id', true), '')::uuid)
  )
public.v_deals.name: v_deals

public.v_employee_performance.definition:
select "employees"."id" as "employee_id", "employees"."tenant_id", "employees"."name" as "employee_name", "employees"."department_id", "deals"."currency", count("deals"."id") as "deal_count", count("deals"."id") FILTER (WHERE "deals"."status" = 'won') as "won_count", count("deals"."id") FILTER (WHERE "deals"."status" = 'lost') as "lost_count", count("deals"."id") FILTER (WHERE "deals"."status" = 'open') as "open_count", coalesce(sum("deals"."amount") FILTER (WHERE "deals"."status" = 'won'), 0) as "won_amount" from "employees" left join "deals" on ("deals"."tenant_id" = "employees"."tenant_id" and "deals"."responsible_employee_id" = "employees"."id") where (
    current_setting('app.analytics_scope', true) = 'tenant'
    OR (current_setting('app.analytics_scope', true) = 'department'
      AND "employees"."department_id" = nullif(current_setting('app.analytics_department_id', true), '')::uuid)
    OR (current_setting('app.analytics_scope', true) = 'employee'
      AND "employees"."id" = nullif(current_setting('app.analytics_employee_id', true), '')::uuid)
  ) group by "employees"."id", "employees"."tenant_id", "employees"."name", "employees"."department_id", "deals"."currency"
public.v_employee_performance.name: v_employee_performance

public.v_tasks.definition:
select "tasks"."id", "tasks"."tenant_id", "tasks"."title", "tasks"."status", "tasks"."assignee_employee_id", "employees"."department_id", "tasks"."due_at", "tasks"."created_at", "tasks"."contact_id", "tasks"."deal_id" from "tasks" inner join "employees" on ("employees"."tenant_id" = "tasks"."tenant_id" and "employees"."id" = "tasks"."assignee_employee_id") where (
    current_setting('app.analytics_scope', true) = 'tenant'
    OR (current_setting('app.analytics_scope', true) = 'department'
      AND "employees"."department_id" = nullif(current_setting('app.analytics_department_id', true), '')::uuid)
    OR (current_setting('app.analytics_scope', true) = 'employee'
      AND "tasks"."assignee_employee_id" = nullif(current_setting('app.analytics_employee_id', true), '')::uuid)
  )
public.v_tasks.name: v_tasks
